content:
此資源包是為我的MCE MPA 實況包設計，但我認為它可能適合每個人。

MCE MPA — Minecraft Explorer Modpack Adventure

A complete Vanilla+ experience on Fabric 1.21.1.
Rediscover Minecraft, enhanced in every aspect: performance, immersion, exploration, survival, and atmosphere.
Slower-paced but richer gameplay. Set out to discover new structures. Face new monsters, while staying as faithful as possible to the spirit of the game.

This pack :

This texture pack adds 3D models in the style of Gray's 3D item for the Progression Reborn mod

Thanks to Caninegray for permission to create this pack
